requirements.title: IEEE_MAX exception signaling rules
requirements.definition: For IEEE_MAX, a signaling NaN operand signals IEEE_INVALID; otherwise no exception is signaled.

pending.IEEE_MAX-signaling-nan-signals-invalid: Probes D = IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(1.0) for IEEE_MAX and IEEE_VALUE, N = IEEE_SUPPORT_NAN(1.0), F = IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(IEEE_INVALID, 1.0) for IEEE_SET_FLAG, IEEE_GET_FLAG, and IEEE_GET_HALTING_MODE, and H = IEEE_SUPPORT_HALTING(IEEE_INVALID) for IEEE_SET_HALTING_MODE. Branch D true, N true, F true, H true: set invalid halting false, clear IEEE_INVALID, evaluate IEEE_MAX(1.0, IEEE_VALUE(1.0, IEEE_SIGNALING_NAN)) and IEEE_MAX(IEEE_VALUE(1.0, IEEE_SIGNALING_NAN), 1.0), and assert IEEE_INVALID true; branch D true, N true, F true, H false with IEEE_GET_HALTING_MODE reporting h false: clear IEEE_INVALID, evaluate IEEE_MAX(1.0, IEEE_VALUE(1.0, IEEE_SIGNALING_NAN)) and IEEE_MAX(IEEE_VALUE(1.0, IEEE_SIGNALING_NAN), 1.0), and assert IEEE_INVALID true; branch D true, N true, F true, H false with h true: skip; unsupported branches skip.
pending.IEEE_MAX-quiet-and-numeric-signal-no-exc: Probes D = IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(1.0) for IEEE_MAX and IEEE_VALUE, N = IEEE_SUPPORT_NAN(1.0), and one F_flag = IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(flag, 1.0) branch for each of IEEE_INVALID, IEEE_OVERFLOW, IEEE_UNDERFLOW, IEEE_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO, and IEEE_INEXACT using IEEE_SET_FLAG and IEEE_GET_FLAG. Branch D true, N true, and current F_flag true: clear that flag, evaluate IEEE_MAX(1.0,2.0), IEEE_MAX(1.0, IEEE_VALUE(1.0, IEEE_QUIET_NAN)), and IEEE_MAX(IEEE_VALUE(1.0, IEEE_QUIET_NAN), 1.0), then assert that flag remains false; unsupported branches are not claimed.
